name: Auren Energia S.A.
summary: Auren Energia S.A. focuses on the development, construction, management, and upkeep of renewable power generation facilities throughout Brazil. Its extensive portfolio encompasses wind, solar, and hydroelectric installations, collectively producing an impressive 3,030 megawatts. The company was formerly identified as VTRM Energia Participações S.A. until its rebranding to Auren Energia S.A. in March 2022. Its central operations are based in São Paulo, Brazil.
